text:
maria-devsec: starting RBAC roles backfill now (migration id rb-2026-03-20-12). estimated ~30m. running in prod shards 1-3.

taylor-db: saw a couple of batch failures 5m in, getting repeated deadlock on users_roles table.

maria-devsec: exact error: 
```
ERROR: deadlock detected
DETAIL: Process 7123 waits for ShareLock on transaction 98765; blocked by process 7121.
```

raj-oncall: cc @kevin-sre — I tagged incidents too. Any customer-facing impact yet? :eyes:

kevin-sre: nothing external reported so far. internal auth checks failing sporadically for a subset of service accounts — they appear to have null role after the backfill crashed.

emily-pm: do we have a list of affected users? need to determine if any paying customers could be impacted.

alice-eng: grabbing logs. looks like backfill script assumed a default role exists and attempted to insert duplicate default rows for some tenants. root cause = non-idempotent insert + long transaction span.

maria-devsec: plan: pause the running job, run a quick safe fix to set DEFAULT_ROLE for users where role is null (non-destructive), then resume backfill with patched script that upserts and batches. anyone object?

taylor-db: suggested command to find affected count: `SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE role_id IS NULL;` also recommend run in read-committed and do batches of 1000.

kevin-sre: +1. propose run the safe update with `BEGIN; UPDATE users SET role_id = <default_uuid> WHERE role_id IS NULL LIMIT 10000; COMMIT;` but Postgres doesn't support LIMIT on updates — use CTID pattern. test on staging first.

maria-devsec: good call. I'll run on staging now and send results.

ops-bot: deployment rb-backfill-v2 started by maria-devsec at 2026-03-20T12:18:03Z :hammer:

alice-eng: staging run: 1,240 rows fixed, no deadlocks. patched script in PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/582. changes: idempotent upsert, batch size env var, resume token table.

raj-oncall: what about the partial transactions left behind in prod? any locks to clear before we re-run?

taylor-db: I've identified 2 stuck transactions on prod hold pids 7121 and 7123. going to safely terminate and wait for cleanup. will notify once cleared.

kevin-sre: after kill, verify no orphaned advisory locks: `SELECT * FROM pg_locks WHERE NOT granted;` and check application logs for retry errors.

maria-devsec: terminated pids, locks cleared. running the safe-fill on prod in 3..2..1.

ops-bot: job rb-safe-fill-prod executed by maria-devsec at 2026-03-20T12:37:22Z — 7,842 rows updated.

emily-pm: thanks — I'll draft a short internal status note and reach out to CS if we see any customer errors.

alice-eng: re-run backfill with patched job now (batch=1k). monitoring metrics and error channel.

ops-bot: rb-backfill-v2 completed at 2026-03-20T13:05:01Z — success.

maria-devsec: closing thread. follow-ups: 1) add a schema constraint to prevent duplicate default_role inserts 2) add a migration-runner test to simulate interruption 3) postmortem next week.

kevin-sre: will own the postmortem + create a playbook entry for backfill deadlocks.

raj-oncall: noted. tagging oncall rotation and marking incident as RESOLVED (minor). :white_check_mark:
